title: Projects / Case Studies
text:
Context: Worked on improving the in-store experience for mobile customers.
Problem: Customers often felt rushed during device setup and plan selection.
Approach: Suggested clearer step-by-step explanation, better signage, and follow-up messages.
Result: Helped reduce repeat visits for the same issue and improved customer satisfaction scores based on informal feedback.





Context: Target to increase activations and accessory sales.
Problem: Some customers left without completing the purchase or choosing the right plan.
Approach: Used needs-based questions, simple explanations of plans, and follow-up calls.
Result: Exceeded monthly sales targets several times and built stronger customer relationships.
